limitations: A same-second pair at t[n0] costs one extra escalation; a same-second K-tuple containing the decline costs a MISSED suppression. Disclosed, not fixed; fixing needs marker time resolution that check shares
A decline suppresses that signature for K-1 further occurrences then re-arms
T3 and T4 discriminate the anchors only if the marker is seeded between the n0-th and (n0+1)-th record; a late marker silently makes T3 pass under every anchor
T6 is vacuous unless it seeds records whose file order is not ascending
No real session in the corpus has ever exceeded the K=3 threshold, so the anchor is pinned by tests and a stated contract, not by history
non_goals: GH #448 missing validate_session_id at the head of check_session_total; this phase adds a validating helper call AFTER the unvalidated read and must not be recorded as fixing it
